blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Friday vowed to properly utilize its proposed P245.44-billion budget for 2027, following an additional P2.913 billion allocation during the Senate’s budget deliberations. During the Senate plenary deliberations on the proposed 2027 national budget on Thursday, the PNP received an additional P2.913 billion on top of its proposed P242.53-billion budget for next year. “We ensure, and we will commit that this will be properly utilized,” PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. told reporters at Camp Crame. READ: PNP seeks P1.5B for infrastructure under proposed 2027 budget In a statement, the PNP said […]...
